target_customer: Technical founders running sales and design calls on Google Meet; the launch post also pitches an AI CMO for software companies
problem: Calls end with action items that take days to complete, and AI note-takers only record; separately, software teams ship faster than they can market.
product_category: AI teammate for video calls (pivoted from AI CMO for software companies)

founders.name: Maanav Agrawal
founders.background_notes: Three-time National Speech and Debate finalist per YC page.

founders.name: Jason
previous_startups: High-school reselling business that grew social accounts
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder in the YC launch post without a last name; a directory lists Jason Zhan, not confirmed on a company page.

competitors.name: Google Ask Gemini in Meet
competitors.what: Private side-panel assistant that answers from live captions
competitors.traction_then: Rolling out from September 2025 to select Workspace customers

competitors.name: Otter.ai and Fireflies.ai
competitors.what: Meeting bots that transcribe and summarize calls
competitors.traction_then: Established note-taker category per a market article

technical_complexity.rationale: Real-time joining of calls, speaker detection of the wake word, a private Mac control app and drafting pages live is moderate engineering with latency constraints.

defensibility.rationale: Google, Anthropic (Claude in Meet, per an unverified source) and note-taker incumbents can add voice agents; no proprietary data.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Google was shipping Gemini in Meet from 2025; no direct action against Memoir found.

market_need_then: AI agents became common in email, browsers and code in 2025 and 2026 while calls still produced only notes; evidence is the YC launch post, not independent demand data.

branding.domain_note: Uses memoirmeet.com and trymemoir.ai (prefix), not memoir.com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Principle-led: 'Private until you share', 'Nothing leaves without you', 'Answers when asked'.

branding.brand_signature: Four short trust principles on the website.
branding.community_and_virality: None found; searches surface unrelated memoir-writing tools and a Chrome extension called Memoir.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with writing apps; the name suits neither the CMO nor the calls product strongly and no brand press exists.

pivots.from: AI company brain knowledge base synced to code
pivots.to: AI CMO for software companies, then AI teammate in video calls
pivots.why: Per the YC launch post, Memoir began as a company brain before the marketing product; the move to calls is shown by the YC page and website. Dates not given.

outcome_analysis: Memoir is a Spring 2026 YC company with two technical founders who met at IMC Trading, still active and pre-outcome. It has already changed direction at least twice, which signals searching for a wedge. Its calls product competes with Google and note-taker incumbents and is in private testing, so the odds depend on finding a distinct use case.
notes: Neuronfeed reports a $500K seed in January 2026; single aggregator, unverified, not recorded. YC page lists team size 1 while naming two founders. Pivot dates are not sourced. Competitor sources are 2025 to 2026 articles.
